profile.headline: Web Dev | Project Manager | Business Owner @ sageyarts
profile.summary: Always open to chatting about new projects, creative collabs, or where to find the best spots in Tokyo!

positions.title: Web Developer and Project Manager
positions.description: Hybrid role containing responsibilities including: front end development work for clients utilizing HTML, CSS, JavaScript, HubL, and Liquid, management of client projects and client communication, and general administrative duties. Work on HubSpot, Wordpress, and Shopify.

positions.title: Owner
positions.description: sageyarts is a Milwaukee-based business producing accessories (hair, decorative), stationary goods, prints, apparel, stickers, and more that feature beloved video game and anime characters! From keychains of Kirby in cowboy boots to prints of Warhol-inspired Pokemon soda cans, as well as all-around silly shirts and tote bags, there's something for everyone to enjoy!

positions.title: Community Representative
positions.description: Researched and troubleshot 500+ weekly homeowner issues with 8000+ clients, documented communication and followed up on outstanding issues. Multi-tasked and maintained a pleasant demeanor at all times.

positions.title: Assistant Manager
positions.description: Promoted to Assistant Manager in August. Processed any necessary item changes or refunds required. Worked with food on line as well as management over coworkers and the retail and cold case area. Researched further engagement and sales plans within this area.

positions.title: Line
positions.description: Worked to create menu item foods. Provided customer service to a busy environment. Accepted and processed phone calls, online orders, and delivery orders.

positions.title: English Teacher
positions.description: Promoted and taught a “student-centered” approach to language learning to 35+ students ranging from ages 5-67 years. Focused on techniques as an on-going foundation of learning. Taught lessons through a series of activities.

positions.title: Advertising Client Services Specialist
positions.description: Coordinated product implementation, including materials collection, routing, proofing, tracking and order system entry. Assisted in post-deployment reporting. Maintained product/placement schedules. Communicated widely on the subjects of materials, deadlines, and project statuses. Managed a specific group of clients.

positions.title: Counselor and Instructor
positions.description: Worked with people of all ages to teach and build rock climbing skills and techniques during the summer base camp, birthday parties, and scheduled groups. Instructed new and upcoming climbers on how to use the equipment, co-ran portable climbing walls at events, and helped around in the climbing gym by doing general and daily tasks.

positions.title: Business Administration Student Office Assistant
positions.description: Provided general assistance and worked closely with students, prospective students, and parents. Answered emails and phone calls for those with questions related to University Housing. Double checked and alphabetized files and relevant paperwork. Delivered mail throughout the University building and Residence Halls. Scheduled appointments.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Journalism, Advertising, and Media Studies, Emphasis: Advertising/Public Relations

honors.title: Graduation with Honors
honors.description: Met at least a 3.5 cumulative GPA and took 6 honors/AP courses.
honors.issuer: Issued by Brookfield Central High School · Jun 2014

volunteerExperiences.role: Cat and Small Animal Socialization Specialist
volunteerExperiences.description: Worked closely with animals to make sure they were fit for a house environment. Communicated and worked closely with fellow workers as well as potential adoptees.
